name: Cold room offline. Harvest still moving.
notice: Fictional rehearsal. No calls, bookings, or food-safety guarantees. All quantities, prices, locations, and conversations are demonstration data.

storages.name: Orchard Cold Store
storages.evidence: We have space for twelve hundred kilos at one to three degrees. Ninety dollars for 24 hours. Our receiving team leaves at two, not five. The quote stands until half past two.

transcript.speaker: CALL-E
transcript.text: This is Harvest Relay's automated assistant. This is a rehearsal about spare cold storage. Could you confirm capacity, temperature, receiving hours and price?

transcript.speaker: Provider
transcript.text: We have space for twelve hundred kilos at one to three degrees. Ninety dollars for 24 hours. Our receiving team leaves at two, not five. The quote stands until half past two.

transcript.speaker: CALL-E
transcript.text: So the last receiving time is 14:00, even though the directory says 17:00. We will send this to the coordinator; nothing is booked.

storages.name: Riverside Fresh Hub
storages.evidence: One thousand kilos, zero to four degrees. Receiving between two and four this afternoon. One hundred fifty dollars for 24 hours. Please decide by half past two.

transcript.speaker: CALL-E
transcript.text: This is Harvest Relay's automated assistant in a demonstration. Can you receive 900 kilograms of strawberries this afternoon?

transcript.speaker: Provider
transcript.text: One thousand kilos, zero to four degrees. Receiving between two and four this afternoon. One hundred fifty dollars for 24 hours. Please decide by half past two.

transcript.speaker: CALL-E
transcript.text: Thank you. This is an availability inquiry, not a booking. A coordinator must confirm the handoff.

storages.discovery: Enough cold space. Receiving starts at 14:00.

storages.name: Hillcrest Warehouse
storages.evidence: Fifteen hundred kilos is fine, and seventy dollars for 24 hours. But this room runs six to ten degrees. We receive until five. Quote valid until half past two.

transcript.speaker: CALL-E
transcript.text: This is an automated availability inquiry in a fictional demonstration. What temperature range can your spare room actually maintain?

transcript.speaker: Provider
transcript.text: Fifteen hundred kilos is fine, and seventy dollars for 24 hours. But this room runs six to ten degrees. We receive until five. Quote valid until half past two.

transcript.speaker: CALL-E
transcript.text: That exceeds the lot's requested zero-to-four-degree range. I will record the mismatch and will not reserve the room.

storages.discovery: Cheapest room exceeds the requested temperature range.

carriers.name: Swift Reefer
carriers.evidence: Our truck takes one thousand kilos at one to three degrees. Pickup at 13:35. Fifty minutes to Orchard or Riverside, forty to Hillcrest. One hundred sixty dollars. Please confirm by 14:30.

transcript.speaker: CALL-E
transcript.text: This is Harvest Relay's automated assistant, running a demonstration. Please confirm load limit, cooling, pickup time, route times and total transport price.

transcript.speaker: Provider
transcript.text: Our truck takes one thousand kilos at one to three degrees. Pickup at 13:35. Fifty minutes to Orchard or Riverside, forty to Hillcrest. One hundred sixty dollars. Please confirm by 14:30.

transcript.speaker: CALL-E
transcript.text: Arrival at Orchard would be 14:25, after their 14:00 closing. Riverside remains a possible match. No transport is booked.

carriers.discovery: Full-load truck arrives at Orchard after receiving closes.

carriers.name: Local Co-op Van
carriers.evidence: We can pick up at 13:10, but seven hundred kilos is our limit. Zero to four degrees. Thirty-five minutes to Orchard or Riverside, thirty to Hillcrest. One hundred dollars. Offer until 14:30.

transcript.speaker: CALL-E
transcript.text: This automated demonstration asks about your refrigerated van. Can it take the entire 900-kilogram lot?

transcript.speaker: Provider
transcript.text: We can pick up at 13:10, but seven hundred kilos is our limit. Zero to four degrees. Thirty-five minutes to Orchard or Riverside, thirty to Hillcrest. One hundred dollars. Offer until 14:30.

transcript.speaker: CALL-E
transcript.text: The van cannot take the full 900-kilogram lot. I will report that constraint rather than silently split the load.

carriers.discovery: Earlier and cheaper, but only 700 kg of capacity.
